use.zh-CN: 弹簧或弹性阻力下的抓握练习
use.en: Grip practice against spring or elastic resistance

caution.zh-CN: 训练器不是握力计，阻力标称值不一定可跨品牌比较
caution.en: A trainer is not a dynamometer; resistance ratings may not compare across brands

evidenceScope.zh-CN: 来源支持训练类别，不是本型号的直接比较试验；结构描述为编辑归纳，具体使用以厂商手册为准。
evidenceScope.en: Sources support the training class, not a direct trial of this device. Mechanical descriptions are editorial; consult the model manual.
